item.title: No Expiration Date
item.description: Is there a deadline on God’s power? Has your situation gone “too far”? In this powerful message, “No Expiration Date” from Book of Jeremiah 32:27, we are reminded of God’s unchanging declaration: “Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for me?” When hope feels outdated and the promise seems past due, God’s power is still fresh, active, and unstoppable. item.title: Offering
item.description: There is a principle of spiritual warfare in this video. For years I suffered with recurring bouts of neuralgia. Then I heard the testimony of a woman who was suffering from sciatica, which is also another very painful nerve condition. She asked the Lord for help and He told her to make her pain an offering to Him. She did that and the pain left.
